title: Packers booed during 'butt-whooping' at home to Falcons

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Packers booed during 'butt-whooping' at home to Falcons
sources.description: The Green Bay Packers' head coach Matt LaFleur says his team got a "butt-whooping" as they lost 35-14 at home to the Atlanta Falcons on Thursday.
